notes.title: The Expedition Update v1.42
notes.content: [p]Yep! The Expedition is now on Medal and now supports Auto-Clipping powered by Medal![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560812/07bfa108a78d815490f3cda7a3b52cde8bef42b0.png"][/img][/p][p](not a promotion but you should download medal!)[/p][h2][b]CHANGES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added Auto-Clipping in the some scenarios:[/p][list][*][p]Player Death[/p][/*][*][p]Chase Ends[/p][/*][*][p]Jumpscares[/p][/*][*][p] Endings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "The Expedition" on Medal (thanks to the support team!)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]FIXES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the Ladder on the last level's material not setting properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs relating to interactions[/p][/*][/list][p]Theres not too much else aside from some backend optimizations, due to the fact im working on quite a lot at the moment :)[/p][p][/p]
